items.title: maintenanceAug 4, 2026Mac OS Beta UpdatesHere you'll find a list of all macOS Beta updates and changes since launch.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Aug 4, 2026
MAC OS BETA UPDATES

The macOS Beta update list focuses on all changes and updates for macOS users during the Beta service. Please check here for what was updated and changed specifically for macOS Beta. Make sure to close and restart your client after an update to ensure you are on the latest build.

Updates:

August 4, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.32.
MapleStory Classic World:

Resolved an issue where the top menu bar appeared in full-screen mode on certain non-widescreen monitors
Resolved an issue causing game controller malfunctions

July 14, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.31.
Minor adjustments to client stability.

July 9, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.30.
Resolved an issue where launching MapleStory through Steam would incorrectly display black borders.

June 17, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.28.
Updated to support Discord Connect feature for macOS.

June 4, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.27.
Resolved an issue where the background for the End User License Agreement was discolored when installing through Steam.
Resolved an issue where the error message for having an outdated client would not show when launching through Steam.

May 21, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.26.
Adjusted for Steam Client Support.

April 30, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.25.
Resolved an issue where a prompt would not show properly in dark mode during the first install.

April 9, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.24.
Resolved an issue where jumping would persist when repeating commands.
Adjusted the Dock Icon and Menu Bar.

February 4, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.21.
NGS will be updated to 5.3.38.0.

January 8, 2026

Some players have reported experiencing drop in FPS while playing through the macOS client.
We recommend turning off all in-game sound related settings as it may help alleviate this issue.

December 19, 2025

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.20.
Resolved an issue where there was a discrepancy with available disc space after installation

items.title: maintenanceAug 4, 2026v.270 Known IssuesHere you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.270 - Ride the Lightning update.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Aug 4, 2026
V.270 KNOWN ISSUES

The Known Issues section focuses on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community, and which our team is actively addressing. Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue. Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.270 - Ride the Lightning update:

KNOWN ISSUES
The Margaret Petal Suit obtained from a Pom Pom Margaret Cloud Set Coupon has the incorrect item image and is displaying the Margaret Petal Dress item instead.
The Margaret Petal Dress obtained from a Pom Pom Margaret Dew Set Coupon has the incorrect item image and is displaying the Margaret Petal Suit item instead.
The Operation: Dive weekly task 'Collect 500 Research Records' automatically completes after a weekly reset.
The Ride or Die Coin Shop will be temporarily unavailable until further notice.
Some Erel Light players are unable to start their 2nd Job Advancement quest.
Players unable to proceed with the quest can do so through the Maple Administrator NPC.
RESOLVED ISSUES
August 4 2026
Resolved an issue where the weekly Mystic Frontier Champions reward UI didn’t function properly.
Rewards can be claimed by closing the client and logging in again.
August 3, 2026
Resolved an issue where the Ride or Die reward UI displayed incorrect rewards.
July 30, 2026
Resolved an issue where renting equipment through Arthur's Equipment Rental with a full inventory would not inform players to create space for the transaction.
Resolved an issue where obtaining a Gigatoad Soul Shard would cause the item to enter the USE inventory instead of Soul Collection.
Resolved an issue where Dawn Warrior's Rising Sun and Falling Moon skills would toggle on/off incorrectly.
Resolved an issue where certain features were not functioning as intended for the Brazil social feature block applied during the v.270 update.
Resolved a visual issue where the background in the Familiar Adventure: Mushroom Shrine map was displayed incorrectly.
Resolved an issue where certain Kinesis story quests were not properly displaying videos.
Resolved an issue where using Origin/Ascent skills during Fever Time would cause the game to lag.
Resolved an issue where the Ignite Cash Shop item image was displayed incorrectly.
Resolved an issue where the Burning Express event was not properly allocating monsters defeated for some players.
Resolved an issue where some collaboration item tooltip text was not properly displayed.
Resolved an issue where the Mover NPC was missing from Henesys on Challenger Worlds.
Resolved an issue where Sia Astelle's Stellar VIII - Sadalmelik skill did interact properly with the Decent Combat Orders skill.
Resolved an issue where Sia Astelle's Stellar VIII - Sadalmelik skill did not appear in the Buff Favorites UI when used with Stellagram Fusion.
Resolved a visual issue where Princess Sakuno's Blessing and the Twilight Bloom V Cores appear as if they are able to level to 50.
Resolved an issue where players were kicked after entering the Darknell boss fight in the Ride or Die event.
July 29, 2026
Resolved an issue where some players were unable to claim Ride or Die rewards.
July 28, 2026
Resolved an issue where the Operation: Dive Research Records was not resetting properly, preventing players from claiming the 500/1000 Record rewards.
July 23, 2026
Resolved an issue where the final hit of Erel Light's skill Eternal Guardian did not trigger properly.
July 22, 2026
Resolved an issue where players were unable to enter Ride or Die through the Libae NPC.

维护公告  
2026年7月22日  
V.270 已知问题  

已知问题部分主要聚焦于对游戏和社区造成重大影响、且我们团队正在积极处理的主要问题。请注意，虽然我们力求涵盖最具影响力的问题，但此列表不会包含所有已报告的问题。请定期查看，以了解这些问题的最新状态、已解决问题信息，或任何新增问题。  

以下为v.270“驾驭闪电”更新中已知及已解决的问题列表：  

**已知问题**  
- “生死时速”硬币商店将暂时关闭，直至另行通知。  
- “行动：潜水记录”商店将暂时关闭，直至另行通知。  
- 埃雷尔·光之永恒守护者技能的最后一击未按预期生效。  
  此问题将在下次例行维护中修复。

items.title: maintenanceJul 28, 2026[Completed] Scheduled Minor Patch Maintenance - July 30, 2026The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 10 hours.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Jul 28, 2026
[COMPLETED] SCHEDULED MINOR PATCH MAINTENANCE - JULY 30, 2026

[Updated 7/30 at 1:56 PM PDT] The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 10 hours. Please restart your Nexon Launcher or Steam to ensure you receive the latest client update.

[Updated 7/30 at 12:50 PM PDT] The maintenance has been extended. We apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused you and thank you for your patience during this time.

We will be performing a scheduled minor patch maintenance starting on Thursday, July 30, 2026 at 5:00 AM PDT (8:00 AM EDT / 2:00 PM CEST / 10:00 PM AEST). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 8 hours, concluding around 1:00 PM PDT (4:00 PM EDT / 10:00 PM CEST / 6:00 AM AEST July 31).

Times:

Thursday, July 30, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 1:00 PM
EDT (UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM
AEST (UTC +10): 10:00 PM - 6:00 AM July 31

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory game servers.

Changes and Updates:

MapleStory will be updated to v.270.2.0.
Monthly Windows Update.
The Operation: Dive Record Shop has been reenabled.
The shop's open period is extended, running from after the July 30 maintenance until August 6 at 23:59 UTC.
The Sol Erda Fragment x10 Coupon can be purchased for 450 coins, with a maximum purchase quantity of 30. The purchase limit has been restored to the corresponding amount at the time after the v.270 maintenance on July 22.
The Sol Erda Fragments and Coupons that were sold due to an incorrect setting in the Operation: Dive Record Shop will be fully recovered.
Any unused Sol Erda Fragment x10 Coupons and Sol Erda Fragments still held were recovered during today's maintenance, and the Kroma Coins used to purchase those coupons have been fully refunded.
If the amount recovered is less than the amount purchased, the remaining amount will be automatically recovered each time the affected character opens the HEXA Matrix / Erda Link UI, and that UI cannot be used until the full amount has been recovered.
6th Job skills and all other in-game content remain fully available.
Once a Sol Erda Fragment has been used, there is no other way to recover it, so the method above was applied to ensure accurate recovery.
In addition, please note that abusing the unfair gains caused by any in-game error may result in account penalties.
Ride or Die Changes:
Increased HP for bosses in Ride or Die as clear times were too short to determine appropriate ranking placement.
The Ride or Die timer will now start when the boss appears to reduce the impact of ping on ranking results.
10-second re-entry cooldown will be added to prevent repeated entries for better results. This is to mitigate luck based factors on re-entry.
Week 2 boss challenges have been reenabled.
Adjusted the Guardian Charm stats: Increases the maximum limit of shields obtained from Mapae/Amulets by 10%/25%/50% → 10%/15%/20%.
Resolved an issue where renting equipment through Arthur's Equipment Rental with a full inventory would not inform players to create space for the transaction.
Resolved an issue where obtaining a Gigatoad Soul Shard would cause the item to enter the USE inventory instead of Soul Collection.
Resolved an issue where Dawn Warrior's Rising Sun and Falling Moon skills would toggle on/off incorrectly.
Resolved an issue where certain features were not functioning as intended for the Brazil social feature block applied during the v.270 update.
Resolved a visual issue where the background in the Familiar Adventure: Mushroom Shrine map was displayed incorrectly.
Resolved an issue where certain Kinesis story quests were not properly displaying videos.
Resolved an issue where using Origin/Ascent skills during Fever Time would cause the game to lag.
Resolved an issue where the Ignite Cash Shop item image was displayed incorrectly.
Resolved an issue where the Burning Express event was not properly allocating monsters defeated for some players.
Resolved an issue where some collaboration item tooltip text was not properly displayed.
Resolved an issue where the Mover NPC was missing from Henesys on Challenger Worlds.
Resolved an issue where Sia Astelle's Stellar VIII - Sadalmelik skill did interact properly with the Decent Combat Orders skill.
Resolved an issue where Sia Astelle's Stellar VIII - Sadalmelik skill did not appear in the Buff Favorites UI when used with Stellagram Fusion.
Resolved a visual issue where Princess Sakuno's Blessing and the Twilight Bloom V Cores appear as if they are able to level to 50.
Resolved an issue where players were kicked after entering the Darknell boss fight in the Ride or Die event.
items.bodyZh: 维护公告 2026年7月28日 [已完成] 计划性小型补丁维护 - 2026年7月30日 [更新于7月30日下午1:56 PDT] 维护已完成，我们已将您背包中的现金商城道具延长10小时。请重启Nexon Launcher或Steam以确保获取最新客户端更新。 [更新于7月30日中午12:50 PDT] 维护时间已延长。对于可能给您带来的不便，我们深表歉意，并感谢您在此期间的耐心等待。 我们将于2026年7月30日星期四凌晨5:00 PDT（上午8:00 EDT / 下午2:00 CEST / 晚上10:00 AEST）开始进行计划性小型补丁维护。预计维护时长约8小时，于下午1:00 PDT（下午4:00 EDT / 晚上10:00 CEST / 2026年7月31日上午6:00 AEST）左右结束。 **时间详情：** 2026年7月30日，星期四 * 北京时间 (UTC +8): 7月30日 晚上8:00 - 7月31日 凌晨4:00 * 太平洋夏令时 (UTC -7): 凌晨5:00 - 下午1:00 * 美国东部夏令时 (UTC -4): 上午8:00 - 下午4:00 * 中欧夏令时 (UTC +2): 下午2:00 - 晚上10:00 * 澳大利亚东部标准时间 (UTC +10): 晚上10:00 - 7月31日上午6:00 **将无法使用的服务：** 所有MapleStory游戏服务器。 **变更与更新：** MapleStory将更新至v.270.2.0版本。 月度Windows更新。 “行动：潜水记录商店”已重新启用。 商店开放时间延长，自7月30日维护后至8月6日23:59 UTC。 Sol Erda碎片x10兑换券可花费450枚硬币购买，最大购买数量为30。购买限制已恢复至7月22日v.270维护后的相应数量。 因“行动：潜水记录商店”设置错误而售出的Sol Erda碎片及兑换券将全部回收。 任何未使用的Sol Erda碎片x10兑换券及Sol Erda碎片已在本次维护期间回收，用于购买这些兑换券的Kroma硬币已全额退还。 若回收数量少于购买数量，剩余部分将在受影响角色打开HEXA矩阵/Erda链接界面时自动回收，且该界面在完全回收前无法使用。 第6转技能及所有其他游戏内容仍完全可用。 一旦Sol Erda碎片被使用，将无法以其他方式回收，因此采用上述方法以确保准确回收。 此外，请注意，滥用任何游戏错误造成的不当收益可能导致账号处罚。 **“生死竞速”变更：** 提高了“生死竞速”中首领的生命值，因为通关时间过短，难以确定合适的排名。 “生死竞速”计时器将在首领出现时启动，以减少网络延迟对排名结果的影响。 将增加10秒重新进入冷却时间，以防止重复进入以获得更好成绩。这是为了减少重新进入时的运气因素。 第2周首领挑战已重新启用。 调整了守护符咒属性：从Mapae/护身符获得的护盾上限提高10%/25%/50% → 10%/15%/20%。 修复了通过亚瑟的装备租赁租借装备时，若背包已满，未提示玩家清理空间的问题。 修复了获得巨蟾灵魂碎片时，物品进入使用背包而非灵魂收集的问题。 修复了黎明战士的“旭日”和“落月”技能错误切换开关的问题。 修复了v.270更新中应用的巴西社交功能区块部分功能未按预期运行的问题。 修复了“伙伴冒险：蘑菇神社”地图背景显示错误的视觉问题。 修复了部分凯内西斯剧情任务未正确播放视频的问题。 修复了在狂热时刻使用起源/升腾技能导致游戏卡顿的问题。 修复了Ignite现金商城道具图像显示错误的问题。 修复了“燃烧快车”活动未正确为部分玩家分配击败怪物的问题。 修复了部分合作道具提示文本未正确显示的问题。 修复了挑战者世界中赫里西安缺少移动NPC的问题。 修复了Sia Astelle的“星辰VIII - Sadalmelik”技能与“高级战斗指令”技能交互异常的问题。 修复了Sia Astelle的“星辰VIII - Sadalmelik”技能在使用“星图融合”时未出现在“增益收藏”界面的问题。 修复了“樱乃公主的祝福”和“暮光绽放V核心”显示可升级至50级的视觉问题。 修复了玩家在“生死竞速”活动中进入Darknell首领战斗后被踢出的问题。
